title: Petition of the Massachusetts Highway Department requesting that the Department of Public Utilities consent to exemptions from the vertical clearance requirements of G.L. c. 160, § 98 for the construction of viaducts, bridges, and overhead roadways over railroad track owned by the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority in connection with the Central Artery/Tunnel Project.
filings: ORDER ISSUED By the Transportation Division, Brian F. Cristy, Director (95-130)
